The design is verified in RTL simulation.
We report resource utilization averaged over seven repetitions using varying random seeds.

Non-monotonic functions are more costly to implement than monotonic functions, though the difference is rather small for the direct hardware implementation and on the order of at most a few hundred LUTs.
The graph-level decomposition clearly shows the cost of inserting additional operators, where the total LUT utilization is up to 1.5× compared to the hardware implementation.
